menu.label: Size
menu.supertip: Make the selected shapes the same height, width, or size. Select two or more shapes to enable. Hold Shift when choosing an option to also align the shapes to the first one selected.

button.label: Size to Tallest
button.supertip: Set every selected shape to the height of the tallest one. Hold Shift to also align their bottoms to the first selected shape.

button.label: Size to Shortest
button.supertip: Set every selected shape to the height of the shortest one. Hold Shift to also align their bottoms to the first selected shape.

button.label: Size to Widest
button.supertip: Set every selected shape to the width of the widest one. Hold Shift to also align their left edges to the first selected shape.

button.label: Size to Narrowest
button.supertip: Set every selected shape to the width of the narrowest one. Hold Shift to also align their left edges to the first selected shape.

button.label: Size Both Larger
button.supertip: Set every selected shape to the largest width and the largest height in the selection. Hold Shift to also align their bottom-left corners to the first selected shape.

button.label: Size Both Smaller
button.supertip: Set every selected shape to the smallest width and the smallest height in the selection. Hold Shift to also align their bottom-left corners to the first selected shape.
